# wso2is_group (Data Source)

Looks up a group by ID or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "wso2is_group" "admins" {
  name = "admins"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Group ID.
- `name` (String) Group name (without the user store prefix).
- `user_store` (String) User store domain of `name`. The default is `PRIMARY`.

### Read-Only

- `member_ids` (Set of String) IDs of member users.
